newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH CHRISTMAS SALES UP AS EXPECTED -AGENCY.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH CHRISTMAS SALES UP AS EXPECTED -AGENCY.

text.p: Christmas retail sales rose an expected 4.5 percent to over three billion markka, Finnish STT news agency quoted managing director Guy Wires at the Finnish federation commerce and trade (KKL) as saying on Friday.

The value of sales was still clearly smaller than in the peak years of the late 1980s and less than last year's 5.3 percent increase since this year's rise in purchasing power has been smaller, Wires was quoted as saying.
This year's level is about the same as in the mid-1980s and the peak level will not be reached until the year 2000, if even then, he said.
